production_validation_equivalence.root_cause: The production artifact is intentionally serialized as IEEE-754 float32 and was compared with an independent float64 recomputation. The observed maximum equals one-half of the float32 spacing at 180 degrees; the frozen 1e-10-degree gate was incompatible with the declared storage type.

technical_endpoint_promoted_only_in_scop.root_cause: Generic acquisition QC measured endpoint occupancy over the complete rectangular field, including pixels outside the acquisition-supported R2/SNR domain. The measurement itself excluded those pixels. A high zero-background fraction therefore demoted six otherwise profile-conforming fields.

next_protocol_rule: V1.3 is outcome-informed engineering development. Its numeric equivalence limits must be derived from the declared float32 storage precision, its acquisition QC must operate on the acquisition-supported domain, and its deployment confirmation must use a new hash-selected set of fields. No v1.2 threshold or result may be overwritten.
claim_boundary: The passing individual observations are descriptive because the protocol failed overall. This is neither an independent biological confirmation nor clinical evidence.
